items.headline: Stocks decline on tech sell-off as concerns over Nvidia fallout persist
items.summary: AP reported renewed pressure on technology shares as investors assessed the Nvidia leadership fallout and awaited Nvidia’s earnings report, with concerns spreading to Asian AI-hardware stocks.

items.headline: The AI boom faces a dot-com reckoning
items.summary: Axios reported that concerns about a retreat in AI investment could become self-reinforcing, potentially broadening an AI-market correction into a wider financial reckoning.

items.headline: Anthropic IPO demand reportedly nearly seven times the offered shares
items.summary: El País reported that demand for Anthropic’s planned offering was nearly seven times the number of shares offered, increasing the IPO’s significance for the broader technology sector amid Nvidia-related turmoil.

items.headline: Nvidia fallout weighs on retirement portfolios
items.summary: Axios estimated that a 30% Nvidia decline would reduce the value of a $100,000 S&P 500 fund investment by about $2,400, assuming an 8% Nvidia weighting and other holdings unchanged.
